payload.text: The wire→types DayCount mapping is a total 1:1 lift of the two day-count bases: `From<WireDayCount> for DayCount` matches Act365Fixed→Act365Fixed and Act360→Act360 explicitly, no wildcard. ACT/365-fixed is kept distinct from ACT/360 because vol-time accrual (ACT/365) must not be conflated with money-market accrual basis (ACT/360) — a deliberate separation (docs/CONVENTIONS.md). This seam carries the basis from the wire onto `celnet_types::DayCount`. Pure: a match returning the mapped enum, no mutation.
